text.text_excerpt: Uxi Duxi is my happy place. I don't get up there often enough, but whenever I do, it's with a headache and an all around cloud of pain, and they take care of me. "I'll give you the maeng da," says the girl at the counter; "it's best for pain." Indeed it is, friend. Thanks for knowing, and for not skimping on the scoopage. Prices aren't bad at all, only $6 for a drink containing a little over 5 gm. (You can also buy an extra boost.) The tea itself is palatable. I like the cold grapefruit version. Can't say it's delicious (it's kratom after all), but they do a fair job of mellowing the natural swamp sludge flavor. That's the only one I've cared to try so can't speak for the kava or CBD stuf...

We walked into this place with only a vague idea of what kratom is and having never heard of kava or had access to CBD oil. The woman behind the counter was patient and extremely knowledgeable, pointing us to a book with several pages of explanations for different items available, including strains of kratom and the variety of edibles they offer. When we approached the counter she answered additional questions and educated us without talking down to us, helped us to choose the right items for ourselves: hubby got an iced kratom special and I ordered a chai kava drink from the permanent menu. My brother-in-law got another of the specials, a kratom pear and lavender tea. I tasted all three ...

I love this place! I have only been twice but had good experiences both times. This is a fun spot to meet with someone. The staff is very friendly and helped me with all my questions. I had the kava chai which was good and the kava dab. Unfortunately I left with a bad burn because I didn't listen when they lady told me it was very hot.. I'll be sticking to my chai next time! One thing to note is the kratom tea is very bitter, and grainy almost. I wouldn't get that again
